reason: A settings-panel utility for discovering, viewing, enabling, disabling, and installing AI skills from local directories, ZIP archives, and GitHub repositories across DSH, Codex, and Claude.

summaries.zh: 在设置页集中查看、启停并从本地 ZIP 或 GitHub 仓库安装 DSH、Codex 和 Claude 的 AI 技能。
summaries.en: Manage AI skills for DSH, Codex, and Claude in one settings panel, including local viewing, enablement controls, ZIP imports, and GitHub installation.

capabilities: Scans local skill directories and reads skill metadata and content
Renames local skill files to enable or disable them
Extracts and installs skills from local ZIP archives
Downloads, searches, and installs skills from configured GitHub repositories
Persists skill-management state and refreshes the settings interface
